subject: Demo request: Developer trial — next steps and available windows

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martin <alex.martin@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: Developer trial — next steps and available windows

Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up for a developer trial — welcome aboard! I'm Rachel (SDR, Redwood Inference). This is an automated follow-up to confirm next steps and give you a direct way to grab a slot for a focused technical walkthrough.

Quick notes:
- What we'll cover: integration options (Hosted, Dedicated, Private), model runtime perf, and a short live demo of provisioning and a sample inference workload.
- Ideal attendees: one backend engineer + an integration owner.
- Length: 30 minutes (we can extend to 45 if you want a deeper kernel-level discussion).

Pick a time that works for you: https://calendly.com/redwood-dev/30min
(pro tip: the link will show times in your detected timezone; if it looks off, reply with your preferred TZ).

Attached is a 1-page developer quickstart to skim before the call: developer-quickstart.pdf (attached).

If you'd rather me propose a few windows, reply with an afternoon preference (PST/EST) and I can send options.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference

Attachment: developer-quickstart.pdf (PDF, 72KB)
From: Alex Martin <alex.martin@acme-corp.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:47:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: Developer trial — next steps and available windows

Thanks Rachel — received, and appreciate the quick follow-up. A couple of things:

1) We are in PST (Pacific). Afternoon windows are generally better for our team (1:00–4:00 PM).
2) We're particularly interested in the Private deployment option and any notes on VPC/KMS integrations — can the walkthrough focus on that?
3) Is there an engineer-friendly agenda (e.g., what logs/metrics you'll show)?

If it's easier, go ahead and propose two afternoons and I'll pick one.

— Alex
Alex Martin
Senior Platform Engineer, ACME Corp
alex.martin@acme-corp.com

Alex — thanks for the details. Afternoon PST works. I added Ben (AE) to loop him in since ACME indicated this is a potential pilot.

I can do the following 30-minute windows (all PST):
- Wed 5/22 — 1:30–2:00 PM
- Wed 5/22 — 2:30–3:00 PM
- Thu 5/23 — 3:00–3:30 PM

Or you can pick any slot directly here: https://calendly.com/redwood-dev/30min

Agenda (engineer-focused, 30 mins):
1) 5 min quick intros + goals
2) 10 min private deployment + VPC/KMS discussion (high-level architecture, KMS integrations, what we do/what you manage)
3) 10 min live demo: deploy model variant, show logs/latency/tokens, and show the Console routing options
4) 5 min next steps & pilot checklist

I attached a short tech one-pager that lists what to have ready (keys, sample repo, expected qps): technical-onepager.pdf.

If none of those windows works, tell me which afternoon on Wed/Thu and I'll propose new times.

Thanks — looking forward.
